g.text: Human RNA reference · index preparation measured separately
Single builds · native/minimap2 configured for 8 threads · BWA/makeblastdb are single-threaded
ooff and BLAST: 8 vCPUs / 16 GiB. BWA build: original 16-vCPU / 32-GiB host; index reused for 8-vCPU search.
minimap2: 8 vCPUs / 32 GiB after a retained 16-GiB OOM. Native forward index only; 0.013% additional intended-gene bases.
Cache state not normalized; includes index serialization. Thread availability does not imply full CPU utilization.
